NCC Education awards the Level 3, Level 4 and Level 5 qualifications. The final Bachelor’s degree is validated and awarded by the University of Greater Manchester, and the top-up programme is delivered online by Western International College Online (WINC). IIHE Cambodia is accredited by NCC Education, not by the university.

q: Is progression to the Bachelor’s degree guaranteed?
a: NCC Education’s university progression partnership provides a guaranteed route to the final Bachelor’s stage, with more than 100 universities across the UK and globally, for students who successfully complete Level 5 and meet the published entry requirements. Our admissions team will explain the conditions before you enrol.

q: Can I start with my BAC II?
a: Yes. Students who have successfully completed the Cambodian Diploma of Upper Secondary Education (BAC II) can enter the NCC Education Level 3 Diploma directly. You need an average of 45% or more (grade D) in 5 subjects, including 45% or more in Maths, and in English if you studied it.

q: Do I need to leave Cambodia?
a: No. You complete the NCC Education stages at IIHE Cambodia and the final degree stage online. You can remain in Cambodia for the full pathway.

If you have taken the IELTS test with a score of 4.5 or above, please submit your result and you will not need the placement test. Please note that the final Bachelor’s degree stage may have its own published English requirements.

q: How long does the full pathway take?
a: The standard route takes four academic years from Foundation to the final Bachelor’s degree stage. Your starting level may be different if you already hold a recognised qualification.
